Tired of renting? With some ‘sweat equity’ this home can be yours! 2219 Square feet includes three large bedrooms and two bathrooms. The kitchen has beautiful brick over the cook top. The brick extends to the living room, creating an awesome fireplace. The large family room has an impressive wooden ceiling.
The master bedroom has a huge closet (7.8X10.4). The inviting soaking tub would be great after a long day at work, or take a dip in the in-ground pool on a hot Texas day! 
This home needs love, paint, and flooring. 
If you love to host family or friend gatherings, this home is the one for you!

2 full bath
